segments.text: This is the entry level: log in as level1 with the standard wargame password level1, confirm the identity, and read the pass file for the next level's credentials.
I log in as level1. The motd lays out the house rules: no rooting, no network access, no personal files in tmp, and the final password opens the Tux wargame.
id confirms uid one thousand one, level1.
The pass file reads level1 - the entry account's own password; the real chain starts at the telnet rot-thirteen service on port six thousand six hundred sixty-six, which is level one's cast.
There is no README and no level1 binary in levels - the entry level has no challenge of its own.
The entry level is done; the next password comes from level one's telnet decode.
